notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (slug far-cry-3-blood-dragon-2, id 19375); RAWG lists "Far Cry 3" as its parent game. Steam app 233270 ("Far Cry 3 - Blood Dragon") was used. None of the 19 Steam achievements is hidden. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0: Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but not written, and no subpages exist. farcry.fandom.com answers the API under "Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon" with about 153 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. "Running man" (after saving Darling, go from combat to stealth with a dragon) is a stealth feat, so it sits in the combat chapter rather than the story.
